label: US-UT-13-72-AIPolicyAct-2024 Utah Code § 13-72-301

obligations.text: The office shall periodically set a learning agenda for the learning laboratory that establishes the specific areas of artificial intelligence policy the office intends to study.

In selecting individuals to consult with under Subsection (3)(b) , the office shall consider: the individual's knowledge of artificial intelligence technology and applications; the individual's expertise in artificial intelligence policy; and the individual's relevant experience.
